summary: FuelCell Energy Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of 10,714,286 shares of common stock at $21.00 per share, with the last reported sale price on July 6, 2026, at $29.73 per share. The offering is expected to raise $213.75 million in net proceeds before expenses, with underwriters granted a 30-day option to purchase an additional 1,607,143 shares. Joint lead book-running managers include Citigroup and Barclays, with several co-managers. This is a routine shelf takedown and not a special situation. What to watch: no special-situation angle as this is an ordinary capital-raising event.
